about.text: a fresh cow's milk pasta filata cheese produced in Italy, it is formed into flat strips of about 4–5 cm wide, 1 cm thick, and folded in on itself in a uniform manner or woven wire. The name stracciata means "tattered" in Italian.

sources.text: fresh pasta filata strips from Molise (Agnone area), pasteurised cow milk, PAT traditional product; shelf days a guess
